text: For a source emitting n equally likely symbols, the Shannon entropy H(X) = -sum(p_i log2 p_i) reaches its maximum value of:
explanation: Entropy is maximized for a uniform distribution, giving log2(n) bits per symbol. H = 0 corresponds to a certain (zero-surprise) outcome; 1 bit is the maximum only for n = 2; n bits confuses the number of symbols with the information they carry.
